pageDescription: Fixed shortcuts that respond while the Last War game window is active.

statusCopy.offline: Game disconnected. Settings are saved and will apply after connection.

cards.title: Attack target
cards.description: Q/W/E/R each send one march at whatever is under the cursor: enemy city, ally city reinforcement, monster, resource node, or city ruin. World bosses and rally monsters are skipped. A/S/D/F recalls.
extraControls: Use speedup items from the inventory
Buy speedups with diamonds when items run out
cards.warning: Items are spent first, cheapest tier first. Diamond purchases pick the lowest-priced tier and spend real diamonds.

cards.title: Shield countdown
cards.description: Hold Space to display remaining Shield time above protected cities.

cards.title: Use Shield
cards.description: F6 uses an 8-hour Shield, F7 a 12-hour Shield, and F8 a 24-hour Shield.
cards.warning: This shortcut consumes the matching Shield item immediately.

cards.title: Equipment preset
cards.description: Apply equipment presets 1–4 to all configured squads.

cards.title: Random relocation
cards.description: Press F9 to use a Random Relocator.
cards.warning: Relocation may consume an item. This shortcut is disabled by default.

cards.title: Alliance relocation
cards.description: Press F10 to relocate to the Alliance rally point.
cards.warning: Relocation may consume an item. This shortcut is disabled by default.

styleFacts: .hotkey-grid uses two equal columns with 10px gap at normal width and one column responsively
.hotkey-card uses a 1px card border, card surface, card shadow, 8px radius, 12px 14px padding and 8px internal gap
.hotkey-binding uses blue text, info border/background, 6px radius, 6px 8px padding and 600 12px/1 Consolas, monospace
.hotkey-danger uses danger text/background, caption size, 6px radius and 7px 8px padding
.hotkey-status uses muted footnote text, 1px line border, soft surface, 7px radius and 8px 10px padding
